name: Java Fundamentals & OOP
description: Classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, abstraction, interfaces, and core Java syntax.

name: Collections Framework
description: List, Set, Map, Queue implementations, generics, Comparable vs Comparator, and choosing the right collection.

name: Concurrency & Multithreading
description: Threads, synchronization, locks, ExecutorService, CompletableFuture, and concurrent data structures.

name: JVM & Memory Management
description: JVM architecture, heap vs stack, garbage collection algorithms, class loading, and JIT compilation.

name: Spring & Spring Boot
description: IoC container, dependency injection, Spring MVC, REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Boot auto-configuration.

name: Streams & Functional Java
description: Stream API, lambda expressions, Optional, method references, functional interfaces, and collectors.

name: Exception Handling
description: Checked and unchecked exceptions, exception propagation, try-with-resources, custom exceptions, and best practices for reliable error handling.

name: Generics & Type System
description: Generic classes and methods, bounded type parameters, wildcards, type erasure, PECS, and Java type-system constraints.

name: Java I/O & NIO
description: Byte and character streams, buffering, serialization, Path and Files APIs, channels, buffers, and asynchronous I/O fundamentals.

name: JDBC & Database Transactions
description: JDBC connections, prepared statements, resource management, transaction boundaries, isolation, batching, and connection pooling.

name: Annotations & Reflection
description: Built-in and custom annotations, retention and targets, reflection APIs, dynamic proxies, and common framework use cases.
